product: Window measures on a numeric index column in metric views
tagline: Window measures support unitless offset and trailing/leading ranges on a consecutive integer order column.
what_it_does: Window measures support unitless offset and trailing/leading ranges on a consecutive integer order column. Use a numeric index for non calendar periods such as fiscal weeks or 4 4 5 periods. Advanced techniques for metric views let you express complex business logic and reuse definitions across your semantic layer.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
